meta.source: Crest artwork supplied by the brand (single PNG). Colors sampled from it; light theme derived.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark value is the artwork's black field; light value is a derived parchment.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs. Dark value is the crest's charcoal fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only (under 3:1 — not for control borders; use gold for those).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised (16:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on either surface (6.6:1+).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The crest gold. Outlines, rules, primary button fill, control borders and focus rings. As TEXT only on dark grounds (9.5:1 on surface-raised dark); on light grounds use gold-text.

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: Highlight gold from the globe. Hover state of gold fills and outlines.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold as text or small icons on the current surface — links, eyebrows, numerals (5.5:1 on parchment).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a gold fill (9.5:1).

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: Champagne light of the silk arcs. Decorative glows and large display accents; not for body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Mid-tone of the silk folds. Decorative fields and chart fills; never text.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Fixed artwork black, same in both themes — hero bands and anywhere the crest sits.

tokens.name: emblem
tokens.usage: Fixed crest charcoal, same in both themes — the fill inside gold outlines.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero titles and posters. Always capitals (Cinzel has no lowercase).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Four rounds. One market. The best strategy takes the floor.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Teams submit their valuation before the round closes.
styles.usage: Running text. Garamond runs small — 17px is the floor for reading.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, eyebrow to title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, gutters on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding, space around the crest.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Rules, full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels — matches the softened feather tips of the crest.

tokens.name: stroke-crest
tokens.usage: Gold outline weight for crest-style frames, cards and button outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers in line colour.
